name: Boston Dynamics Stretch
summary: A mobile robot with one long arm and a suction gripper that unloads floor-loaded cartons up to 50 lb (about 23 kg) from trailers and containers onto a conveyor, for up to 16 hours per charge.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request through Boston Dynamics sales; its European office near Frankfurt handles local sales and service. In Germany, Otto Group runs Stretch at the Hermes Fulfilment centre in Haldensleben; DHL Supply Chain has expanded Stretch to the UK and across Europe. No public price.

sellers.name: Boston Dynamics (European office near Frankfurt)
sellers.note: European office co-located at Hyundai WIA near Frankfurt for local sales, service and field engineering. Stretch sales via the web form.

specs.label: Unloading rate
specs.conditions: up to, reported in DHL deployments

specs.label: Gripper
specs.value: Suction gripper with multipick (several boxes per swing)

specs.label: Load types
specs.value: Floor-loaded trailers and shipping containers; case picking

notes: Payload stated as 50 lb per case; 22.7 kg is the converted value.
Works at dock doors with a conveyor; it moves between docks inside the warehouse.
No pre-programming of box sizes; operator certification typically takes two days (Otto case study).
Built for warehouse cartons, not for construction-site work.
